goal: Make a fresh ChatGPT run fail closed when visible-evidence integrity, persistence verification or closeout is skipped: add the CLAIM_OWNER_ON_PAGE and MANDATORY_EVIDENCE_ON_PAGE pre-render QA gates and a pure local run-contract operator CLI with a runbook.
acceptance_conditions: pre_render_qa takes a required crosswalk keyword and emits CLAIM_OWNER_ON_PAGE and MANDATORY_EVIDENCE_ON_PAGE.
Fracto-style S001 without LoanIQ and J.Jill-style S003 with SQL/Pandas without LoanIQ fail CLAIM_OWNER_ON_PAGE.
A mandatory SQL requirement whose LoanIQ claim appears only in skills fails MANDATORY_EVIDENCE_ON_PAGE.
The corrected real-data fixture (LoanIQ single project, B017+B018, no MarketMind) passes and is one-page-capable.
B017 under Winter Walk still fails.
The run CLI is pure and local; package persists exactly three files and verify-persisted is exact on names, sizes and SHA-256.
record-submit requires exactly one of --bora-confirmed or --receipt-file; closeout ends with the exact CAREER_OS_RUN_CLOSEOUT status line.
review_requirements: STOP after PR creation for independent review. Do not merge.
stop_conditions: Out of scope; STOP rather than broaden: matcher, qualification-gate, pursuit-authority or submission semantic changes; automatic bullet selection, fit scoring, cover-letter runtime, auto-submit; multi-project resume schema redesign; Drive, Sheets, web or any other external platform work, including PDF backfill or Ledger edits; changes to the canonical cloud adapter bytes.
Any need to change matcher, gate, pursuit or submission semantics, the cloud adapter bytes, or the resume schema, or to touch Drive/Sheets.
human_approval_requirements: Bora retains consequential approval; merge and every Ledger/Drive write remain with Bora and the ChatGPT connectors.
